name: Fenn ear branch topology v001 (shared by c1 / c2 and E1 / E2 / E3)

blocks.bridge: front only: attachment line A (c0 -> c1) | notch curve U (c0f -> c1f), sides D_att / B_att (j_f edges); attached concha floor / tragus region
blocks.F1: front + back: crescent behind the concha (U lower part | posterior rim P_lo -> P_up; lobe front D' | cut Y -> P_up)
blocks.F2: front + back: upper extension kite (U upper part | posterior upper rim P_up -> tip; anterior helix c1f -> tip | cut)
blocks.rim: K_r rows of quads round the free outline c0f -> lobe -> posterior rim -> tip -> anterior helix -> c1f (helix roll)
blocks.cuff: root band (v005 root valence kept at 4) + 5 rings 52 / 56 / 60 / 64 / 68 to the junction ring (70); count changes by DP-matched +/-2 transition quads (canonical per side)
blocks.transition: one bounded ring of v005 vertices outside the root loop, repositioned by the fairing (topology unchanged)

parameterisation: every sheet vertex carries fixed W1e ear parameters (s along the ear, t across: -1 anterior edge .. +1 posterior rim; rim rows interpolate front -> back); candidates and heads differ only in the parameter -> geometry map (outline, relief, orientation, head scale), never in topology
